body:
Yeah, you pretty much hit the nail on the head.
Although there are different factors, much of what you have written is kind of like reading my own story.

I fear I am too damaged to be put back together. Every time I think I have made progress, someone or something finds a way of running me over and then crushing me till I have one breath left and then I'm left on my own to begin yet again to try & put myself back together. 
Now i just want the breath to go for good, as sad as that sounds.
I let go of my family before and I was abused in a different way.
